metric: Descriptive max absolute field difference divided by the finest reference peak, floor1e-12, mean-free pressure. This is separate from the original model accuracy normalization. A finest-to-itself zero is not an accuracy pass.
limitations: All64trials passed native stability gates, but stability and the finest comparator do not establish continuous-time accuracy.
Some pulse/fast-motion cases have substantial timestep sensitivity and near-zero reference pressure can inflate relative pressure differences.
One-second low-frequency windows do not prove full-cycle fidelity; a no-activity trial does not qualify pulse response.
Only this small rectangle at25/100cells/m received these physical trials. Native force previews cover all6densities separately.
